2184. Find the Frequency of Elements Using calloc()

80

Hard

Write a C program to count the frequency of each distinct integer in an array using Dynamic Memory Allocation.

Your program should:

Read an integer N.

Allocate memory for N integers using  calloc() .

Read N integer elements.

Identify each distinct element.

Count how many times each distinct element occurs.

Print each distinct element along with its frequency in the order of first occurrence.

Release all allocated memory using  free() .
input_spec:
First line contains N.

Second line contains N space-separated integers.
output_spec:

20 2
30 1
40 1
